index.md.Plugin permettant de gérer le délestage: Plugin allowing to manage the electrical load shedding
index.md.Le plugin gère 3 types de délestage: The plugin manages 3 types of load shedding
index.md.Le délestage intelligent nécessite le pl: Smart load shedding requires the Thermostat plugin to operate
index.md.Le plugin classe les thermostats en fonc: The plugin classifies the thermostats according to their actual temperatures according to the set temperatures
index.md.Ainsi le délestage interviendra en prior: Shedding will therefore take priority over the parts with the smallest deviation
index.md.La gène pour les occupants sera ainsi mo: The gene for the occupants will be less important
index.md.Le délestage s'effectue en mode hiérarch: Load shedding is carried out in hierarchical mode on the x actuators
index.md.L'actionneur 1 sera délesté en priorité: The actuator 1 will be relieved in priority then the 2, 3…
index.md.Les actionneurs seront réenclenchés dans: The actuators will be reset in the reverse order of load shedding
index.md.Le délestage s'effectue en mode rotatif: Load shedding is performed in rotary mode on the actuators defined for the cyclic mode, then if the power is still greater than the threshold, in hierarchical mode on the others
index.md.Voici les paramètres à configurer sur le: Here are the parameters to configure on the plugin
index.md.sélectionner ici la commande qui renvoie: select here the command which returns either the power or the amperage (in this case it will be necessary to configure the network voltage
index.md.Seuil à partir duquel le déléstage se dé: Threshold from which deletion will be triggered
index.md.Il est possible de définir des actions c: It is possible to define additional actions in addition to load shedding actions
index.md.Il est, par exemple, possible d'envoyer: It is, for example, possible to send an sms to warn of the beginning and the end of load shedding
index.md.Les paramètres suivants peuvent être rég: The following parameters can be set
index.md.Tension du réseau en Volts (220V par déf: Network voltage in Volts (220V by default
index.md.Délai avant réactivation en mins (5 mns: Time before reactivation in mins (5 mins by default
index.md.délai avant lequel les équipements ne se: time before which the equipment will not reactivate (to avoid overly repetitive on / off
index.md.Délai minimum entre les relevés en s (10: Minimum time between readings in s (10s by default
index.md.Pour l'instant seul le plugin thermostat: For now only the official thermostat plugin is managed by intelligent load shedding
index.md.Il est cependant possible d'utiliser les: It is however possible to use the other 2 load shedding modes with the other thermostats
index.md.Attention à bien activer le mode \"Auto\: Be careful to activate the "Auto" mode on the widget in order to activate load shedding
